basic_info.description: Stunning house-like in scale and feel, this super spacious, sun-filled, FULLY REMODELED 3BR/3BA condo boasts an EXPANSIVE 1,639 SQFT of elegant living space in the highly desirable Outer Richmond! Complete with WATER VIEWS and CITY VIEWS, all bedrooms are GRAND PRIVATE ENSUITES that are generously sized, with large closets and wrap-around double-paned windows that flood the entire home with natural light. The beautifully remodeled interior features a comfortable open floor plan and a cozy fireplace, flowing seamlessly into a warm and welcoming living and dining area. The gourmet kitchen includes quartz countertops, all new stainless steel appliances, and customized cabinetry. The luxurious bathrooms are complete with deep soaking tubs, double vanity sink, and sleek modern finishes. Additional highlights include new paint, refinished flooring, IN-UNIT LAUNDRY w/ hookups, and an oversized independent GARAGE PARKING. Located in a secure, ELEVATOR building with intercom access, this unit is just steps away from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Land's End, and the vibrant Balboa and Clement St corridors. Enjoy nearby top-rated schools, MUNI access, local markets, and restaurants. Don't miss your chance to see this move-in ready home that checks off all of your boxes!
